reasons: The disclosed lake record is verified and identifies New York v. Quarles, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1984-06-12.
The official citation in the lake record is 467 U.S. 649, matching the content page citation; the listed parallel and vendor citations also match the disclosed record.
residual_risks: No external source was consulted, per instruction.

defect.evidence_quote: We conclude that the need for answers to questions in a situation posing a threat to the public safety outweighs the need for the prophylactic rule protecting the Fifth Amendment’s privilege against self-incrimination.
defect.locator_note: text/New York v. Quarles__0b6d75.txt line 17; page marker *657 precedes the quoted sentence.
defect.problem: The quote is substantively supported and located at page 657, but it is not character-faithful: the disclosed opinion text uses a curly apostrophe in Amendment’s while the lake/content quote uses a straight apostrophe.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace "Amendment's" with "Amendment’s" in the pin-657 quote if exact character fidelity is required.

reasons: The disclosed text contains the same sentence at the asserted page 657 location.
The only observed fidelity defect is typographic apostrophe normalization, not a substantive quotation error.
residual_risks: Lake pin-657 has page null and pinpoint_status slip-only, so structured page metadata should be populated separately.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Store the exact opinion-text punctuation for verbatim quotes, or mark typography-normalized quotations as non-exact.

defect.evidence_quote: We hold that on these facts there is a “public safety” exception to the requirement
defect.locator_note: text/New York v. Quarles__0b6d75.txt line 13 contains the holding passage; lake pin-655 instead contains a malformed content-page fragment.
defect.problem: The pin-655 quote stored in the lake/inventory is not the opinion’s holding quote. It splices built-page background prose with markdown headings and does not appear as a verbatim passage in the disclosed opinion text.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-655 with the actual holding passage beginning "We hold that on these facts there is a “public safety” exception..." and map it to 467 U.S. 655-56.

reasons: Lake pinpoints[pin-655].quote reads "; the officer retrieved a loaded revolver. ## Issue ... ## Rule Yes.", which is not opinion text.
The opinion text at the relevant location contains the public-safety-exception holding, not the malformed markdown fragment.
residual_risks: The content page’s displayed pin-655 quote is closer to the opinion but still should be checked for exact typography and ellipsis handling after the lake pinpoint is repaired.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Prevent content-page headings or surrounding prose from being ingested as authority pinpoint quotes.

reasons: Treatment/currency is outside Lens A, so no treatment finding is raised.
The content page treatment fields match the disclosed lake fields: field_i_validity good_law, as_of_content 1984-06-12, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, varies_by_point false, and the same scope note.
residual_risks: Lens B should evaluate currency, negative-treatment edges, and good-law status.
